lines: The wind is a little strong
It shakes my heart too much
continues to shine right before me
That was a summer when the sky was still blue
The love of that day, which we could laugh at as nostalgic
you, staring with eyes about to cry
with a cloud‑like tenderness, gently and tightly
Hold me, hold me, never let go
aren't strong enough to pour out
A silhouette that remains etched in my eyes
the two of us breathing slightly cold air
on this day we walk, clenching our teeth
talking about what name to give it
Ah, the words I love you
because the clouds still leave our shadows
Even if we're in a faraway place
I want us to stay connected
That was a summer when the sky was still blue
The love of that day, which we could laugh at as nostalgic
you, staring with eyes about to cry
with a cloud‑like tenderness, gently and tightly
Hold me and never let go
Ah, the words I love you
because the clouds still leave our shadows
Ah, forever, forever, never let go
